title: Packers fear Edgerrin Cooper suffered torn Achilles in win over Buccaneers

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Packers fear Edgerrin Cooper suffered torn Achilles in win over Buccaneers
sources.description: Matt LaFleur called the injury "not good" after the game, and the emerging defensive star is suspected to miss the rest of the year after being carted off against Tampa Bay
